snapshot.ec-ai-act: 2026-07-27 (baseline, first scan): GPAI transparency duties (Art.50), AI Office enforcement powers and the penalty regime become active 2026-08-02; Art.50(2) machine-readable AI-content marking has a grace period to 2026-12-02. Digital Omnibus on AI signed 2026-07-08, pending Official Journal publication, defers only HIGH-RISK obligations (2026-08-02 to 2027-12-02) — Binge's Ask Binge (Gemini) and recap (Claude) features are limited-risk/GPAI-based, not Annex III high-risk. Repo already carries Art.50 user-facing disclosures.
snapshot.ec-dsa-enforcement: 2026-07-27 (baseline, first scan): DSA enforcement maturing; child-protection-provision scrutiny trending toward smaller platforms, but reporting ties expansion to platforms with 50+ employees/EUR10M turnover. Binge (solo-founder) sits below that bar. Core DSA duties already covered by villkor/community-guidelines and the submitReport Cloud Function.
snapshot.ec-news: 2026-07-27 (baseline, first scan): headline item is the Digital Omnibus AI track — final act signed 2026-07-08, awaiting Official Journal publication. Separate Data Omnibus (GDPR/ePrivacy/NIS2/DORA amendments) remains in negotiation, not adopted.
